app_store.name: Creative Activities
app_store.subtitle: Sana'o'i da Wasannin Hoto
app_store.promotional_text: Ku yi wani abu tare: sauƙaƙan ayyukan ƙirƙira, manyan katunan hoto da hotunan iyalinku. Babu na'urar lokaci, babu maki, babu asusu.
app_store.description:
Nemo wani sauƙaƙan aiki da za ku ji daɗinsa tare. Creative Activities yana ba da haɗa hotuna cikin natsuwa da kallon hotuna tare ga iyalai da masu kulawa, har da waɗanda suke zama tare da mutumin da ke rayuwa da mantuwa (dementia) ko cutar Alzheimer.

KA FARA DA ƘANƘANTA
Ka fara da manyan katuna huɗu da hotunan zane na farko da aka saba gani. Bar hotuna a bayyane, ko ka ɓoye su idan hakan ya fi dacewa. Yanayin natsuwa ba shi da na'urar lokaci, maki, ko hukunci. Zaɓi katuna 4, 6, 8, ko 12 gwargwadon samuwa.

SA SHI YA ZAMA NA KANKA
Zaɓi hotunan iyali ta amfani da mai zaɓen hoto na na'urarka. Creative Activities yana adana ƙananan kwafi don ayyukan cikin na'ura; ba ya bincika ma'ajiyar hotunanka kuma ba ya canza ainihin hotunanka. Za ka iya riƙe hotuna har 24 a cikin tarin guda.

KAWAI KU KALLA TARE
Ka duba hoto ɗaya a lokaci guda. Tambayoyin tattaunawa na zaɓi suna gayyatar hira ba tare da neman kowa ya tuna sunaye ko ya bayar da amsa madaidaiciya ba. Kallo kawai ya isa.

BA INTANET, A INDA YAKE DA MUHIMMANCI
Hotunan zane na farko suna samuwa nan take. Kwafin hotunan da aka shigo da su suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba bayan shigo da su. Zaɓen ainihin hotuna da ke cikin iCloud kawai na iya buƙatar intanet. Dukkan fakitin hotuna takwas suna cikin manhajar, ba tare da saukar da hotuna daban ba.

BABU ASUSU KO SAMFURIN DAIDAITA HOTUNA
Kwafin hotunan iyali suna zama a cikin manhajar a wannan na'ura. Za ka iya cire kwafin ba tare da goge ainihin hotuna ba. Ajiyar na'ura na iya haɗawa da bayanan manhajar. Wannan sigar ba ta daidaita hotuna tsakanin dangi.

Creative Activities na nishaɗi ne da tattaunawa tare. Ba ya gano cuta, ba ya magani, ba ya hanawa, kuma ba ya auna mantuwa ko cutar Alzheimer. Ayyukan ba su dace da kowa ba; bi sha'awar mutumin da jin daɗinsa, kuma ka daina ko ka canza aikin idan ya zama dole.
app_store.release_notes: Clearer screens for playing together. The first picture game spreads each pair apart. Plan my day, Daily moment and other pages fit better with large text, and text follows your phone's size up to twice the normal size. Look together no longer counts the pictures. In Today, help numbers are labelled for the U.S., with a note to use a local number elsewhere. Translations are machine-made and not yet reviewed. If anything reads wrong, tell us from Help and privacy.
